experimental_calibration: 120 exploratory synthetic streams used to inspect fixed and adaptive policy cost before freezing; not counted in holdout.
method: Same 200 seeded synthetic observations evaluated by six pre-frozen policies; after the first 240 observations, policies consume sequential chunks 40 up to 240; rational thresholds replaced by synthetic floating point sample medians; cost-aware heuristic uses two same decisions with stricter slope margins, not optimized expected cost.
negative_controls: Fixed80 caused 16 false confirmations and 9 false rejections; premature decisions highly penalized.
Fixed240 made no mistakes but paid for 48,000 samples versus 29,160 under conservative adaptive.
SG029 adaptive policy made two false confirmations on new holdout and lost despite lower observation count.

retrieval_log.result: Inspected policy cost; excluded from holdout
2406 assertions passed; cost-aware 200/200 correct, 1749.6 cost vs fixed240 2880.0

limitations: Cost penalties are designed illustrative units, not measured dollar cost or regulatory risk.
Cost-aware is a conservative manually defined policy, not proven optimal.
Holdout seeds new, but generative family and noise distribution same as calibration; no out-of-distribution evidence.
Synthetic binary64 simulation; no physical or mathematical theorem proved.
No causal evidence of source copying or model-training access
next: SG031 test loss sensitivity, novel noise/drift regimes, and whether a calibrated expected-value acquisition policy outperforms heuristic stopping without hiding mistakes.
